response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with nearly 18 years in the industry, meeting the minimum experience requirement. His background is impressively broad, spanning web, mobile, and embedded systems, and he demonstrates entrepreneurial initiative through his founding of GISCollective. However, his direct experience with AI strategy and building AI-powered products appears limited and very recent. While his current role involves AI agent infrastructure, his resume does not yet reflect the deep, recognized expertise or strategic leadership in AI that this Director-level Principal role requires.
strengths: Extensive tenure (~18 years) and broad technical expertise across multiple domains.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit and leadership through founding an open-source platform and organizing technical workshops.
Recent hands-on experience with emerging AI agent infrastructure and tooling.
concerns: Lacks the specified seniority for a Director-level Principal role; highest title is Staff Engineer.
Limited demonstrated experience in defining AI strategy or shipping major AI-powered products.
Absence of an advanced degree in an AI-related field, which is a preferred qualification.
